metadata.title: Chris Blair signs reserve/future contract with Falcons
metadata.description: The Falcons signed WR Chris Blair to a reserve/future contract.
metadata.analysis: Blair spent time on the Falcons practice squad. He will be under contract with Atlanta heading into its offseason program.

metadata.title: Chris Blair - Sticking around Atlanta
metadata.description: The Falcons signed Blair to a reserve/future contract Monday, Tori McElhaney of the team's official website reports.
metadata.analysis: Blair spent the entirety of the 2025 campaign as a member of the practice squad with Atlanta, appearing in three contests in December. The wide receiver played 12 snaps on offense in those games, failing to record any stats on those snaps. Blair will now get an opportunity to train with the Falcons during the offseason, and he'll look to impress in order to attempt to get a shot with the active roster in 2026.

metadata.title: Chris Blair - Reverts to practice squad
metadata.description: Blair reverted to the Falcons' practice squad Tuesday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Blair was elevated to the active roster and played in Monday's 27-24 win against the Rams. However, he was limited to just six snaps on special teams (and logged one tackle on kick coverage) despite Casey Washington and Malik Heath both being healthy inactives for the game. It was the third and final time that Blair was eligible to be elevated from the practice squad, so he would have to be signed to Atlanta's active roster in order to be available for Sunday's regular-season finale against New Orleans.

metadata.title: Chris Blair elevated by Falcons for Week 17
metadata.description: The Falcons elevated WR Chris Blair from their practice squad for Monday's game against the Rams.
metadata.analysis: Blair played on a handful of snaps last week. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Chris Blair - Elevated for Week 17
metadata.description: The Falcons elevated Blair from the practice squad to the active roster ahead of Monday night's game against the Rams, Josh Kendall of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: It's the third and final time that the Falcons are allowed to elevate Blair from the practice squad this season. He would have to be signed to the active roster in order to be eligible to play in Atlanta's regular-season finale against New Orleans on Sunday. Blair played in Weeks 15 and 16 but did not record a target.

metadata.title: Chris Blair - Back to practice squad
metadata.description: Blair reverted to the Falcons' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Blair played nine of 77 offensive snaps in Sunday's win over the Cardinals but wasn't targeted in the passing game, as he operated as Atlanta's WR4 behind Darnell Mooney, Drake London and David Sills. Blair doesn't have a catch across two appearances this season.

metadata.title: Chris Blair - Elevated for Week 16
metadata.description: The Falcons elevated Blair from the practice squad Saturday in order for him to play Sunday against the Cardinals, Tori McElhaney and Terrin Waack of the team's official site report.
metadata.analysis: Blair will operate as a depth wide receiver while also contributing on special teams versus Arizona. He handled three snaps on offense and five snaps on special teams versus the Buccaneers in Week 15. Blair will revert to the practice squad after Sunday's contest.

metadata.title: Chris Blair - Reverts to practice squad
metadata.description: Blair reverted to the Falcons' practice squad Friday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: The Falcons elevated Blair from the practice squad ahead of Thursday night's showdown with the Buccaneers. The wide receiver and special teamer logged three offensive snaps and five special teams snaps in the win over the division rival.

metadata.title: Chris Blair - Set for 2025 debut
metadata.description: Blair is active for Thursday's game against Tampa Bay, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Blair has spent the last few seasons with Atlanta, primarily working on the practice squad. That's been the case again this season, as this is his first elevation and will be his first game action of 2025, assuming he earns snaps in Thursday's contest.

metadata.title: Chris Blair - Elevated for TNF
metadata.description: The Falcons elevated Blair from the practice squad to the active roster for Thursday night's game against the Buccaneers, Terrin Waack of the team's official reports.
metadata.analysis: This will be Blair's first elevation of the season, an opportunity the wide receiver has likely waited for since signing to the practice squad Aug. 27. The Falcons now have a whopping 10 wide receivers on their roster for Thursday's game, meaning Blair was likely elevated to serve in a special teams capacity. The 28-year-old logged 20 total special teams snaps for the Falcons through four games last season, and will likely have similar volume Thursday night.
